subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Amicable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Friendly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amicable"** means having a spirit of friendliness; without serious disagreement or rancour. (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **They reached an **amicable **agreement after hours of negotiation.
 
 
 
• **"Friendly" **refers to being kind and pleasant, showing friendship. (मित्रवत)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a **friendly **demeanour that makes everyone feel at ease.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'amicable'** is **'friendly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Proud** (गर्वित): Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt **proud **of her accomplishments.
 
 
 
• **Generous** (उदार): Showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected.
 
 
• **Example:** He is very **generous **with his time and resources.
 
 
 
• **Harsh** (कठोर): Unpleasantly rough or jarring to the senses; cruel or severe.
 
 
• **Example:** The **harsh **weather conditions made it difficult to continue the journey.
